scope: Fresh direct inspection of wardrobeai source files for the source-to-PC reconstruction. Source excerpts are independent supplemental records; REA records remain unchanged in all-evidence.json.

records.description: The activity obtains TryOnViewModel through the Android ViewModel delegate and installs TryOnScreen inside ClosetOrganiserTheme.
records.raw_excerpt: class TryOnView : ComponentActivity() { private val viewModel: TryOnViewModel by viewModels(); override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) { ... setContent { ClosetOrganiserTheme { TryOnScreen(viewModel = viewModel) } } } }
records.normalized_finding: Launcher activity owns Compose setup and supplies its ViewModel to the single try-on screen.
limitations: The Android framework lifecycle dispatch is not observed at runtime.

records.description: Screen observes six ViewModel StateFlows, opens the platform image picker for person and clothing, renders either the input flow or result, and connects result actions to save and reset methods.
records.raw_excerpt: collectAsStateWithLifecycle() for photo/result/loading/error/success state; GetContent() launches with image/*; resultBitmap != null selects ResultView; callbacks call saveImageToGallery and tryAnotherOutfit.
records.normalized_finding: The user journey is one screen with two image inputs, generation, result preview, save and repeat actions.
limitations: Image picker behavior and snackbar/toast presentation are platform runtime behavior.

records.description: MutableStateFlows hold the selected URIs and bitmaps, result, generation flag and transient messages. The clear actions remove the corresponding data; tryAnotherOutfit keeps the person photo and clears clothing, result and messages.
records.raw_excerpt: _userPhotoBitmap, _clothingPhotoBitmap, _resultBitmap, _isGenerating, _errorMessage and _successMessage are MutableStateFlows; tryAnotherOutfit() clears clothing/result/messages only.
records.normalized_finding: The source workflow is in-memory; repeating an outfit preserves the person photo while resetting the garment and result.
limitations: No persistence of this state is implemented in the inspected ViewModel.

records.description: Selected content URIs are decoded on the IO dispatcher after a bounds-only pass and sampled to a maximum dimension of 1024; load failures set role-specific error messages.
records.raw_excerpt: setUserPhoto/setClothingPhoto call loadSampledBitmap(context, uri, 1024); null results set 'Failed to load user photo.' or 'Failed to load clothing image.'.
records.normalized_finding: Both source inputs are downsampled to roughly 1024px maximum dimension before use.
limitations: The source sampling loop is preserved as an observation; exact Android BitmapFactory decode results vary by input format.

records.description: Generation rejects a missing person image first and a missing clothing image second, then clears the error, marks generation active, calls the generator on IO, stores a non-null result, reports generic failure otherwise, and resets the active flag in finally.
records.raw_excerpt: if (userBmp == null) { _errorMessage.value = 'Please upload your photo first.'; return }; if (clothingBmp == null) { _errorMessage.value = 'Please select a clothing image first.'; return }; finally { _isGenerating.value = false }
records.normalized_finding: Validation order and the one-at-a-time loading/result/error transitions are explicit in the ViewModel.

records.description: The app tries three named Gemini models in order, builds a generateContent POST with a text prompt and two JPEG inlineData parts, requests IMAGE and TEXT, and accepts the first returned inline image. A non-success or response without an image advances/fails the attempt.
records.raw_excerpt: FALLBACK_MODELS = [gemini-3.6-flash, gemini-3.1-flash-image, gemini-2.5-flash-image]; responseModalities = [IMAGE, TEXT]; both photos are Base64 JPEG parts.
records.normalized_finding: Gemini is an optional generation integration; results come from the first image response among sequential model attempts.
limitations: No API request was sent during this source analysis; credentials, endpoint availability, model support, cost and quality remain unverified.

records.description: Fallback creates an output bitmap the size of the person photo, draws that photo, then draws the entire clothing image into a centered destination rectangle of 68% person-photo width starting at 28% person-photo height. It performs no segmentation or body fitting.
records.raw_excerpt: clothingW = userW * 0.68f; clothingH = clothingW * clothingBmp.height / clothingBmp.width; left = (userW-clothingW)/2; top=userH*0.28f; canvas.drawBitmap(clothingBmp, srcRect, destRect, paint)
records.normalized_finding: The offline fallback is a fixed rectangular overlay rather than AI garment fitting.
limitations: The source calls it a realistic composite, but that label does not establish realistic segmentation or alignment.

records.description: A missing result produces an error. Otherwise the result is written as a timestamped PNG to Pictures/WardrobeAI through MediaStore, with pending state on Android Q+ and distinct success/failure messages.
records.raw_excerpt: WardrobeAI_<timestamp>.png; MIME image/png; RELATIVE_PATH Pictures/WardrobeAI; IS_PENDING set and then cleared on Android Q+.
records.normalized_finding: The app exports only the generated result and reports save outcome.
limitations: Storage API and permission behavior are Android-version-specific.

records.description: The manifest declares INTERNET, READ_MEDIA_IMAGES, READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE through SDK 32, and WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE through SDK 28.
records.raw_excerpt: android.permission.INTERNET; android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES; READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE maxSdkVersion=32; WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE maxSdkVersion=28
records.normalized_finding: Android permissions support outbound API calls, picking/reading image content and legacy gallery writes.
limitations: The PC implementation replaces these permissions with browser file selection and a user-initiated download.

records.description: The Android module targets SDK 35/minimum SDK 29, uses Compose, Kotlin, Hilt/KSP, Google Services, OkHttp logging interceptor and Timber-Kt. It reads GEMINI_API_KEY from local.properties into a generated BuildConfig field.
records.raw_excerpt: compileSdk=35, minSdk=29, targetSdk=35; geminiKey is read from local.properties and written to BuildConfig.GEMINI_API_KEY.
records.normalized_finding: The PC app can avoid Android/Gradle dependencies and keep any Gemini credential outside browser source and source control.
limitations: local.properties was deliberately not read and no secret value is recorded here.

records.description: No test source files were found in the app test source sets; Gradle reports testDebugUnitTest and Android test compilation as NO-SOURCE.
records.normalized_finding: No existing Android behavior tests were available to port or treat as parity evidence.
limitations: Generated build artifacts are not source tests.
